## o11yag-oa — agent operations, observed by OneAgent

The same agent stack as upstream (o11yag-otel), with all OpenTelemetry code removed and Dynatrace OneAgent injected into every pod in namespace `o11yag-oa`. Two data sources, and every tile says which one it uses:

- **Audit records.** The services write one JSON object per line to stdout (`o11y.audit()`). OneAgent log monitoring ingests them, but **merges each JSON line into the log line printed just before it** and does not parse the JSON. Every audit tile therefore splits `content` on newlines and parses the audit lines itself. Measured 2026-10-01: none lost, the per-service counts match `kubectl logs`.
- **OneAgent spans.** Request spans, `openai.chat` / `openai.embeddings` spans with `gen_ai.*` model and token attributes, Redis calls. `dt.service.name` is `app` for every Flask service, so tiles group by `k8s.workload.name` instead.

Upstream's `o11yag.*` metrics and custom span attributes do not exist here. The bottom section lists what OneAgent does not capture.

2.title: Tickets handled
2.description: Tickets the orchestrator completed (one o11yag.ticket.handled record each).
2.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa" and (contains(content, "o11yag.ticket.handled"))
| fieldsAdd line = splitString(content, "\n")
| expand line
| filter startsWith(line, "{\"audit.event.type\"")
| parse line, "JSON:a"
| fieldsAdd ev = a[`audit.event.type`]
| filter in(ev, {"o11yag.ticket.handled"})
| fieldsAdd intent = toString(a[`audit.intent`]), outcome = toString(a[`audit.outcome`]), intent_source = toString(a[`audit.intent_source`]), latency_ms = toDouble(a[`audit.latency_ms`]), llm_calls = toDouble(a[`audit.llm_calls`]), tokens = toDouble(a[`audit.tokens`]), cost_usd = toDouble(a[`audit.cost_usd`])
| summarize tickets = count()

3.title: Error rate
3.description: Share of tickets with outcome=error. Escalated and blocked are not errors.
3.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa" and (contains(content, "o11yag.ticket.handled"))
| fieldsAdd line = splitString(content, "\n")
| expand line
| filter startsWith(line, "{\"audit.event.type\"")
| parse line, "JSON:a"
| fieldsAdd ev = a[`audit.event.type`]
| filter in(ev, {"o11yag.ticket.handled"})
| fieldsAdd intent = toString(a[`audit.intent`]), outcome = toString(a[`audit.outcome`]), intent_source = toString(a[`audit.intent_source`]), latency_ms = toDouble(a[`audit.latency_ms`]), llm_calls = toDouble(a[`audit.llm_calls`]), tokens = toDouble(a[`audit.tokens`]), cost_usd = toDouble(a[`audit.cost_usd`])
| summarize n = count(), err = countIf(outcome == "error")
| fieldsAdd error_rate = if(n > 0, 100.0 * err / n, else: 0.0)
| fields error_rate

13.content: ### Tools, approvals, refunds — from `o11yag.tool.*`, `o11yag.approval.*` and `o11yag.crm.refund_issued` audit records

14.title: MCP tool calls
14.description: o11yag.tool.called (with approval status) and o11yag.tool.blocked (with the gate's decision). 'blocked (timeout)' is a refund over AUTO_APPROVE_MAX_EUR that nobody decided.
14.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa" and (contains(content, "o11yag.tool.called") or contains(content, "o11yag.tool.blocked"))
| fieldsAdd line = splitString(content, "\n")
| expand line
| filter startsWith(line, "{\"audit.event.type\"")
| parse line, "JSON:a"
| fieldsAdd ev = a[`audit.event.type`]
| filter in(ev, {"o11yag.tool.called", "o11yag.tool.blocked"})
| fieldsAdd tool = toString(a[`audit.tool`]), result = if(ev == "o11yag.tool.blocked", concat("blocked (", toString(a[`audit.decision`]), ")"), else: concat("called, approval ", toString(a[`audit.approved`])))
| summarize calls = count(), by: {tool, result}
| sort calls desc

15.title: Approval wait, longest per minute (s)
15.description: waited_s on o11yag.approval.decided, by who decided. Approvals that time out never get a decided record and do not appear here.
15.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa" and (contains(content, "o11yag.approval.decided"))
| fieldsAdd line = splitString(content, "\n")
| expand line
| filter startsWith(line, "{\"audit.event.type\"")
| parse line, "JSON:a"
| fieldsAdd ev = a[`audit.event.type`]
| filter in(ev, {"o11yag.approval.decided"})
| fieldsAdd waited_s = toDouble(a[`audit.waited_s`]), decided_by = toString(a[`audit.decided_by`])
| makeTimeseries max_wait_s = max(waited_s), by: {decided_by}

16.title: Refund decisions
16.description: issue_refund approvals: who decided, what, and how long it waited.
16.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa" and (contains(content, "o11yag.approval.decided"))
| fieldsAdd line = splitString(content, "\n")
| expand line
| filter startsWith(line, "{\"audit.event.type\"")
| parse line, "JSON:a"
| fieldsAdd ev = a[`audit.event.type`]
| filter in(ev, {"o11yag.approval.decided"})
| filter a[`audit.tool`] == "issue_refund"
| fieldsAdd decided_by = toString(a[`audit.decided_by`]), decision = toString(a[`audit.decision`])
| summarize decisions = count(), avg_wait_s = avg(toDouble(a[`audit.waited_s`])), by: {decided_by, decision}
| sort decisions desc

18.content: ### Answers and security — from `o11yag.answer.*`, `o11yag.retrieval.ungrounded`, `o11yag.feedback.received` and `o11yag.security.*` audit records

19.title: Retrieval top score
19.description: Best similarity score per question. 'refused' = below MIN_SCORE, answered with the no-policy reply instead.
19.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa" and (contains(content, "o11yag.answer.generated") or contains(content, "o11yag.retrieval.ungrounded"))
| fieldsAdd line = splitString(content, "\n")
| expand line
| filter startsWith(line, "{\"audit.event.type\"")
| parse line, "JSON:a"
| fieldsAdd ev = a[`audit.event.type`]
| filter in(ev, {"o11yag.answer.generated", "o11yag.retrieval.ungrounded"})
| fieldsAdd top_score = toDouble(a[`audit.top_score`]), kind = if(ev == "o11yag.retrieval.ungrounded", "refused (below floor)", else: "answered")
| makeTimeseries top_score = avg(top_score), by: {kind}

20.title: Answer quality
20.description: Judge verdict on each generated answer (supported / unsupported).
20.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa" and (contains(content, "o11yag.answer.generated"))

| parse line, "JSON:a"
| fieldsAdd ev = a[`audit.event.type`]
| filter in(ev, {"o11yag.answer.generated"})
| fieldsAdd verdict = toString(a[`audit.quality_verdict`])
| makeTimeseries answers = count(), by: {verdict}

21.title: Verdicts, by who decided them
21.description: decided_by=heuristic means the judge model's reply was unusable and the deterministic check decided.
21.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa" and (contains(content, "o11yag.answer.generated"))

| filter in(ev, {"o11yag.answer.generated"})
| fieldsAdd verdict = toString(a[`audit.quality_verdict`]), decided_by = toString(a[`audit.quality_decided_by`])
| summarize answers = count(), by: {decided_by, verdict}
| sort answers desc

22.title: Human feedback
22.description: POST /feedback verdicts. Empty until someone sends feedback.
22.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa" and (contains(content, "o11yag.feedback.received"))
| fieldsAdd line = splitString(content, "\n")
| expand line
| filter startsWith(line, "{\"audit.event.type\"")
| parse line, "JSON:a"
| fieldsAdd ev = a[`audit.event.type`]
| filter in(ev, {"o11yag.feedback.received"})

23.title: Security detections
23.description: Injected instructions in retrieved documents, poisoned tool descriptions, and tool catalogue changes, by action taken. Empty is the healthy case.
23.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa" and (contains(content, "o11yag.security.injection_detected") or contains(content, "o11yag.security.tool_poisoned") or contains(content, "o11yag.security.tool_catalogue_changed"))
| fieldsAdd line = splitString(content, "\n")
| expand line
| filter startsWith(line, "{\"audit.event.type\"")
| parse line, "JSON:a"
| fieldsAdd ev = a[`audit.event.type`]
| filter in(ev, {"o11yag.security.injection_detected", "o11yag.security.tool_poisoned", "o11yag.security.tool_catalogue_changed"})
| fieldsAdd kind = replaceString(ev, "o11yag.security.", ""), action = coalesce(toString(a[`audit.action`]), "observed")
| makeTimeseries detections = count(), by: {kind, action}

24.content:
### What OneAgent sees — spans

Everything in this section is captured by OneAgent with no code in the app. LLM calls come from OneAgent's OpenAI-SDK sensor (code module 1.347.49). The openai.chat spans checked carry model, token and finish-reason attributes but no prompt or completion text.

25.title: LLM calls (OneAgent)
25.description: openai.chat and openai.embeddings spans per minute, by service.
25.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa"
| filter in(span.name, {"openai.chat", "openai.embeddings"})
| makeTimeseries calls = count(), by: {k8s.workload.name, span.name}

26.title: LLM call latency p90 (s) (OneAgent)
26.description: openai.chat span duration. This is the time to the gateway and back, including Ollama.
26.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa"
| filter span.name == "openai.chat"
| fieldsAdd seconds = duration / 1s
| makeTimeseries p90_s = percentile(seconds, 90), by: {k8s.workload.name}

27.title: LLM tokens by service and model alias (OneAgent)
27.description: gen_ai.usage.* on openai.chat spans. support-judge is the knowledge worker's answer judge.
27.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa"
| filter span.name == "openai.chat"
| summarize input_tokens = sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), output_tokens = sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), calls = count(), by: {k8s.workload.name, gen_ai.request.model}
| sort calls desc

28.title: Endpoints (OneAgent)
28.description: Server spans, health checks excluded. p50/p90 duration.
28.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa"
| filter span.kind == "server" and not endsWith(span.name, "/health")
| summarize requests = count(), failed = countIf(request.is_failed == true), p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p90 = percentile(duration, 90), by: {k8s.workload.name, span.name}
| sort requests desc

29.title: Which services share a trace (OneAgent)
29.description: Distinct services per trace. mcp-crm and litellm never appear; Ollama traces stand alone.
29.query:
fetch spans
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "o11yag-oa"
| filterOut endsWith(span.name, "/health")
| summarize workloads = collectDistinct(k8s.workload.name), by: {trace.id}
| fieldsAdd services_in_trace = arrayToString(arraySort(workloads), delimiter: " + ")
| summarize traces = count(), by: {services_in_trace}
| sort traces desc

30.title: Services with no spans (OneAgent)
30.description: Span count per workload that upstream instruments or that sits on the request path. 0 = invisible to tracing here.

31.content:
### What OneAgent does not capture here (measured 2026-10-01, compare docs/TELEMETRY.md)

- **The MCP hop.** `o11yag-mcp-crm` (uvicorn/ASGI) produces no spans, and the action worker's MCP calls (httpx2) produce no client spans. The tool calls are visible only as `o11yag.tool.called` audit records.
- **The model gateway.** `o11yag-litellm` produces no spans. Ollama's own spans (`POST /api/generate`, `/api/embed`) land in traces of their own, so an LLM call is not joined to the Ollama work behind it.
- **loadgen, Qdrant, Redis server.** No spans. Redis appears only as client spans from approvals.
- **Agent structure.** No step, tool, judge or approval-wait spans, and no `step.decided_by`: who chose each tool call is not recorded anywhere here.
- **Business metrics.** No `o11yag.*` metrics; the ticket tiles compute the same numbers from audit records at query time.
- **Trace id on audit records.** None, so audit records cannot be joined to traces. Upstream's refunds tile depended on that join.
- **Service names.** All Flask services are detected as `app`, and `k8s.deployment.name` arrives masked (`o*yag-…`).
